Name: SMS/Voice MFA retirement check
Description: Shows SMS and Voice authentication method policy scope, migration and registration campaign state, and what the Feb 2027 retirement of Microsoft-provided SMS/Voice means for the tenant. Read-only.

Parameters.Name: IncludeDisabledTargets
Parameters.Label: Include disabled targets
Parameters.HelpText: Also list targets kept on a disabled SMS or Voice method. They are not active scope and are marked as such.
